name: Ra

categories.label: Starting tablets
categories.help: Fame you start with: two 5-point tablets, so enter 10.

categories.label: Gods
categories.help: God tiles you hold at the end of the epoch; 2 fame each.

categories.label: Pharaohs
categories.help: Fame for Pharaoh majority: +5 for most, -2 for fewest, nothing if all equal; enter the net, which may be negative.

categories.label: Nile and floods
categories.help: Nile plus flood tiles counted this epoch; 1 each, but enter 0 if you hold no flood tile.

categories.label: Gold
categories.help: Gold tiles at the end of the epoch; 3 fame each.

categories.label: Civilization
categories.help: Fame for civilization tiles: -5 for none, 5 for three different, 10 for four, 15 for five; enter the net.

categories.label: Zero-floor correction
categories.help: Fame you get back when losses would push your tablets below zero, so your total stays at 0 (normally 0).

categories.label: Monuments, different kinds
categories.help: Final epoch only: 1 per different monument up to 6, 10 for seven kinds, 15 for all eight.

categories.label: Monuments, matching sets
categories.help: Final epoch only: 5 for each group of three identical monuments, 10 for four, 15 for five.

categories.label: Suns
categories.help: Final epoch only: +5 if your suns add up highest, -5 if lowest, nothing if all equal; enter the net.

categories.label: Highest sun number
categories.help: The highest numbered sun you own; the higher wins a tie.

notes: Base game only. The publisher PDF on riograndegames.com returned 403, so this was read from a third-party mirror (kubix.com.ua) of the English rules; it was not OCR. That text covers 3-5 players, so the later 2-player rule of the 2009 edition is not verified and not included. Fame cannot go below zero in the rulebook, so enter any correction under the zero-floor category. The tie-break compares highest numbered sun among tied players.
